abilities.name: Soothing Mist
abilities.description: Activate to remove all Stun, Root, Slow, and Silence effects from nearby allied Heroes. Passive Brightwing heals nearby allied Heroes for 110 every 4 seconds.; 75; trait

fields.notes: Expands to its maximum radius over 0.6 seconds. Passive heal does not trigger if Brightwing and all targetable allied Heroes in range are at full Health, but instead remains at 0 cooldown and automatically activates just after any valid target takes damage. Upon entering a Vehicle, the cooldown from the Passive is frozen at its value prior to entering, and resumes counting down from there upon exiting.

abilities.name: Arcane Flare
abilities.description: Shoot a flare dealing 75 damage to enemies hit, and an additional 105 damage to enemies in the center. If a Hero is hit by the center, Soothing Mist's passive healing instantly activates.

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.description: Polymorph a target for 1.5 seconds, Slowing their Movement Speed by 30% and Silencing them. Targets are not able to attack while Polymorphed.

fields.notes: Polymorph counts as a Silence and Slow effect. Abilities that interact with Silences and Slows also affect Polymorphed targets.

abilities.name: Pixie Dust
abilities.description: Increase target's Movement Speed by 20%, and grant them 30 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing Spell Damage taken by 30%.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Blink Heal
abilities.description: Charge Cooldown 9 Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200. Stores up to 2 charges.; 9 / 2; 40; heroic

abilities.name: Emerald Wind
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 damage and pushing enemies away.; 50; 90; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Knockback, Stationary channel
fields.notes: Expands to its maximum radius over 1.625 seconds of animation. Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10-second cooldown.

abilities.name: Phase Shift
abilities.description: After 2 seconds, teleport to an allied Hero and heal them for 25% of their maximum Health.

fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Ability is interrupted if Brightwing directly targets an ally who enters Stasis at any time during the cast.

talents.name: Greater Polymorph
talents.description: Passive Increase Polymorph's range by 30%. If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.
_raw_fields: Passive Increase Polymorph's range by 30%. If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.

talents.name: Hyper Shift
talents.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Bonus stacks multiplicatively with healing modifiers.

_raw_fields: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Pixie Charm
talents.description: Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured Mercenary. Passive Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.
_raw_fields: Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured Mercenary. Passive Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.

talents.name: Dream Shot
talents.description: Increase Arcane Flare's range by 60%. Hitting a Hero with Arcane Flare's center reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

talents.name: Unstable Anomaly
talents.description: Increase Polymorph's Slow by 15%. Upon expiration, Polymorph deals damage to nearby enemy Heroes equal to 2% of their maximum Health.

talents.name: Magic Spit
talents.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.
_raw_fields: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

talents.name: Sticky Flare
talents.description: Enemies hit by Arcane Flare have their Movement Speed Slowed by 20% for 3 seconds. Increase the Slow to 40% if they are hit by the center portion.
_raw_fields: Enemies hit by Arcane Flare have their Movement Speed Slowed by 20% for 3 seconds. Increase the Slow to 40% if they are hit by the center portion.

talents.name: Peekaboo!
talents.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 point Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Critical Mist
talents.description: Soothing Mist heals for 165. Increase this by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

fields.notes: Bonus healing from removing a disabling effect stacks additively with healing modifiers that affect healing dealt and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received.

talents.description: Pixie Dust gives 50% bonus Movement Speed, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.

talents.name: Safety Dust
talents.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other healing modifiers that affect healing dealt and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received.

talents.name: Hush!
talents.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage debuff stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target's damage output.

_raw_fields: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Critterize
talents.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. Damage taken is only increased by 25% assuming no positive Armor is in play. E.g. at 75 positive Armor, applying this debuff doubles the relative damage the enemy Hero takes.

_raw_fields: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

talents.description: cooldown 20 Active Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

fields.notes: Phase Out cannot be canceled. Brightwing retains collision during Phase Out.
